_comment: Issue #109: the field-mode HUD launcher chips canonical. Same near_tactician fixture/opening as mouse_loop/hotbar_tab_loop (inn, warrior L1, player at (2,3)) so the chip-driven proofs below are directly comparable to those scripts' keyboard/click ones. Proves: (title) a title-row CLICK reaches Continue (the mouse_loop precedent, cheap re-derivation here since this script needs its own boot anyway). (A) the journal chip opens/closes the journal via its new public toggle_open() entry -- the EXACT ui_journal_shown/ui_journal_hidden pair the 'journal' keyboard action already fires, with player_cell/actions_since_sleep UNCHANGED by the tap (a chip tap is presentation-only, never a sim action). (B) the inventory chip does the same for ui_inventory_shown/ui_inventory_hidden. (C) the pause chip opens the pause menu (ui_pause_shown), a CLICK on the already-clickable 'Settings' row (issue #84, row 8) opens Settings for real (ui_settings_shown + ui_settings_rendered logged -- Settings needs no chip of its own per the issue, only the pause chip), 'Back' returns to the pause list, and Resume closes it (ui_pause_hidden) -- player_cell/actions_since_sleep still untouched by the WHOLE chip-driven detour.

steps._comment: == A: journal chip == opens via the new toggle_open() entry (field_chips.gd calling journal.gd's public wrapper around its own _open()/_can_open() gate), then closes the SAME way (the chip is a toggle, matching the 'journal' key's own behavior).
== B: inventory chip == same open/close toggle proof via inventory.gd's own new toggle_open() entry.

== C: pause chip -> the ALREADY-clickable Settings row (issue #84) -> Settings actually opens == Settings needs no chip of its own per the issue brief; the pause chip is the one new launcher it needs.

assert_event_logged (whole-log scan), not wait_for_event: settings_loop.json's own precedent -- the all-defaults ui_settings_rendered snapshot fires as part of open() itself, BEFORE ui_settings_shown, so it is already behind the forward-only wait cursor by the time ui_settings_shown resolves.
row 13 = 'Back' (last settings row, shifted by 'Credits...' GH#147 -- matches settings_loop's own row-13 click).
